kitchen.title: Interface kit
kitchen.intro: Every building block of Fannan's interface, in one place. Check each one against the design files.
kitchen.typeDisplay: Your next job is looking for you.
kitchen.typeBody: Put your best work on one link, made for the studios and clients who hire.
kitchen.inputError: Someone already has that name. Try one of the suggestions.
kitchen.cardText: White, 1px line, 22px corners. Cards don't get a shadow; only floating things do.
kitchen.modalText: Your changes go live at your address. You can keep editing afterwards; nothing changes until you publish again.
kitchen.emptyText: Turn on “Available for work” so studios know they can reach you.
kitchen.iconsNote: Arrows, undo/redo and the publish plane flip in Arabic. Objects stay as they are.
kitchen.configNote: Read from config/plans.json, never typed by hand.

usernameProblems.too-long: Keep it to 30 characters or fewer.
usernameProblems.bad-characters: Use only English letters, numbers and hyphens.
usernameProblems.hyphen-edges: Hyphens go between words, not at the end or twice in a row.
usernameProblems.reserved: That name is kept for Fannan. Try another one.
usernameProblems.blocked: That name isn’t allowed. Try another one.
usernameProblems.taken: Someone already has that name. Try one of the suggestions.
